appendix.title: Drug-resistant TB (RR / MDR / pre-XDR / XDR) — admission, tests and management

items.t: Xpert MTB/RIF Ultra, TB-NAAT or culture reports rifampicin resistance
Child with TB disease and an RR-TB source case, or failing first-line treatment despite good adherence
Adults: never treat DR-TB without laboratory confirmation (molecular or phenotypic)
Children may be clinically diagnosed and still registered for RR-TB treatment
RR-TB: rifampicin resistant ± other drugs (includes MDR, pre-XDR, XDR)
XDR: RR + fluoroquinolone + bedaquiline or linezolid resistant
Isoniazid mono-resistant (Hr-TB): RHZE + levofloxacin ≥ 6 months — not this appendix
